mapper.select: SELECT ad.id, bus_no, name, category_code, ad.type_code, model_number, total_volume, manufacturer_text, price_type_code, yb_flag, yb_no, hvcm_flag, ad.status_enum, description FROM adm_device_definition ad INNER JOIN adm_charge_item_definition ac ON ad.id = ac.instance_id WHERE ad.id = #{equipmentId} AND ad.is_deleted = 0
